about: The first licensed joggers (wave 5, Paul's decision 13: clean cuffs, consistent geometry and proper leg deformation): BlenderKit's Grey sweat pants (CC0) through the intake onto the realistic body. `refine` (refine_joggers.py) is the scripted Blender work decision 11 gives to people: the legs shortened and tapered to the ankle with the cuffs gathered, edge loops at the knee, the waistband closed at the waist, hems and cuffs turned with thickness, the back pockets closed, a drawcord added, new texture coordinates and the source's maps baked onto them. Paths are relative to --downloads.

item.label: Fleece joggers
item.about: Grey fleece joggers with an elastic waistband and drawcord, gathered cuffs at the ankle and two back patch pockets, from BlenderKit's Grey sweat pants (CC0).

source.author: Introspective Mnisi
source.evidence: The asset's page (blendkit.com/asset-gallery-detail/e46f029b-7877-41fd-a870-60b98fc2a259, retrieved 2026-11-18, saved as retrieved: SHA-256 be9c0222e32926087fe8c5dcbd5c09b0366a48cab44fb48c7b41ab68518720a6) names the asset 'Grey Sweat Pants', the author 'Introspective Mnisi' and the licence 'Creative commons zero', and describes it as 'Low poly, retopologized and game-ready sweat pants for that easy going look.' The public API record (blenderkit.com/api/v1/assets/e46f029b-7877-41fd-a870-60b98fc2a259/, saved as retrieved: SHA-256 309b20cbe252885ba8b33e3fa5829fbd83cdbc45364dfc7b489ea1a70474ddc7) gives "license": "cc_zero", "isFree": true, verificationStatus "validated", created 2026-09-07. BlenderKit's licensing FAQ (blendkit.com/docs/licenses/licensing-faq/, saved: SHA-256 c7db5b389d7e46709d6af79d8be9588a543a268099c0af56dd73c21ba4c231ff) says the CC0 licence 'technically allows you to do anything with the assets'. Derivation: the glTF's mesh is named 'male_casualsuit06.001'. MakeHuman's system asset male_casualsuit06 (makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip, its .mhclo SHA-256 9cebda22a0fa57fc556a1a77723f59b176724dc7e987c01214283677444ddcc5) says in its header: 'This asset was explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020', its copyright holders at the release Data Collection AB and two MakeHuman developers; MakeHuman's LICENSE.md (github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman) says 'These assets have been released under CC0 1.0 Universal', lists 'Clothes (any MHCLO-based asset)' and points to LICENSE.ASSETS.md, the CC0 1.0 legal code. Compared at MakeHuman's scale (decimetres to metres), the pants lie a median 17 to 20 mm from the suit's surface: the same garment, retopologized, lengthened and loosened. So both the upload and what it was made from are CC0. Authorship of the upload: the uploader is a new BlendKit author (the asset was created 2026-09-07) and the page says nothing of MakeHuman; that the uploader made it could not be confirmed. BlenderKit's position on CC0 models says authors may later ask to exclude assets from redistribution; the page as retrieved is kept beside the record (Pants_FleeceJoggers.source-page.txt).
